source_limitations: Oxford pages were directly opened for sense and grammar on 2026-11-02. Cambridge CEFR labels came only from public search-index publisher snippets; direct Cambridge requests returned HTTP 403. Indexed labels and Oxford topic tags do not establish independently approved exact-sense CEFR. Proposed bilingual alternatives are unapproved AI/editorial research.

frozen_original.english_definition: The amount of a product or service that people want to buy.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: ဝယ်လိုအား၊ လိုအပ်ချက်
frozen_original.example_sentence: Demand for reusable packaging is increasing.

oxford_direct.scope: Uncountable/singular customer desire to purchase, distinct from countable strong request and plural obligations

cambridge_indexed.observed_sense: demand noun NEED; need for goods to be sold or supplied

records.evidence_note: Frozen B1 commercial-demand example matches Oxford customer-demand sense; Cambridge indexed Advanced Learner's Dictionary shows B2 for demand noun NEED. Frozen definition says amount, which may blur desire/need with quantity demanded. Human adjudication required.
records.proposed_english_definition: Customers' need or desire to buy a product or service.
records.proposed_myanmar_meaning: ကုန်ပစ္စည်း သို့မဟုတ် ဝန်ဆောင်မှုတစ်ခုကို ဝယ်ယူလိုသည့် ဝယ်လိုအား။
records.proposed_original_example: Demand for repaired pallets rose after the price change.

frozen_original.english_definition: An amount of something available for use.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: ထောက်ပံ့ပစ္စည်း၊ ရရှိနိုင်သည့်ပမာဏ
frozen_original.example_sentence: The village has a limited supply of clean water.

oxford_direct.scope: Countable amount available, distinct from plural relief supplies and uncountable act of supplying

cambridge_indexed.observed_sense: No reliable exact-sense Cambridge CEFR badge observed

records.evidence_note: Frozen B1 example 'a limited supply of clean water' correctly illustrates countable supply; Burmese gloss 'ထောက်ပံ့ပစ္စည်း' may suggest the supplied item rather than the quantity available. No exact-sense CEFR label established.
records.proposed_english_definition: An amount of something that is available for people to use.
records.proposed_myanmar_meaning: အသုံးပြုရန် ရရှိနိုင်သည့် ပစ္စည်း သို့မဟုတ် အရင်းအမြစ်ပမာဏ။
records.proposed_original_example: The clinic has a limited supply of clean drinking water.

frozen_original.english_definition: An important or noticeable part of something.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: ထူးခြားသည့် အင်္ဂါရပ်
frozen_original.example_sentence: A useful feature of this phone is its long battery life.

oxford_direct.scope: Countable distinctive/useful characteristic, distinct from plural facial features

cambridge_indexed.observed_sense: No reliable exact-sense Cambridge CEFR badge observed

records.evidence_note: Frozen phone-battery example refers to a beneficial characteristic, not necessarily a separate software function. Oxford distinguishes characteristics and facial features. Myanmar gloss is plausible but should clarify feature as characteristic/function where context requires. No CEFR conclusion.
records.proposed_english_definition: A noticeable or useful characteristic of a thing.
records.proposed_myanmar_meaning: အရာတစ်ခု၏ ထင်ရှားသော သို့မဟုတ် အသုံးဝင်သော အင်္ဂါရပ်။
records.proposed_original_example: One useful feature of the app is its offline dictionary.

frozen_original.english_definition: To formally ask for a job, place, or opportunity.
frozen_original.example_sentence: You can apply for the course online.

oxford_direct.scope: Formal application for a job/course, distinct from apply-to rules and practical use

cambridge_indexed.observed_sense: apply verb REQUEST; intransitive formal request

records.evidence_note: Frozen 'apply for the course' uses formal request; Cambridge indexed B1 REQUEST matches POS and broad sense. Oxford Working life a2 is a topic label, not exact-sense CEFR evidence. This remains unapproved.
records.proposed_english_definition: To make a formal request for a job, a course place, or another opportunity.
records.proposed_myanmar_meaning: အလုပ် သို့မဟုတ် သင်တန်းဝင်ခွင့်အတွက် တရားဝင် လျှောက်ထားသည်။
records.proposed_original_example: Students can apply for the scholarship before Friday.

frozen_original.english_definition: The official power to make decisions or enforce rules.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: အာဏာပိုင်ခွင့်
frozen_original.example_sentence: The manager has the authority to approve the request.

oxford_direct.scope: Uncountable power/right to act, distinct from permission and plural authorities as officials

cambridge_indexed.observed_sense: authority noun POWER; legal or moral right or ability to control

records.evidence_note: Frozen manager's authority to approve matches Oxford power/right to act, not the plural 'authorities'. Cambridge indexed POWER label B2; its moral/legal-right framing is broader, so exact-sense alignment needs human adjudication. Avoid equating authority with the official person.
records.proposed_english_definition: The official power or right to make a decision or give permission.
records.proposed_myanmar_meaning: ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်ချရန် သို့မဟုတ် ခွင့်ပြုချက်ပေးရန် တရားဝင် လုပ်ပိုင်ခွင့်။
records.proposed_original_example: Only the supervisor has the authority to approve the refund.
